skill.name: twitter-automation
skill.description: Automate Twitter/X posts, searches, user lookups, bookmarks, lists, media uploads, and likes through Rube MCP and the Twitter toolkit.
skill.summary: Guides authenticated Twitter/X workflows through Rube MCP tool discovery and action sequences.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks around Rube and Twitter tool names, not executable code. The hardcoded Rube MCP endpoint is a real external network dependency, and the skill enables authenticated public posting and destructive account actions. No prompt injection text was found in SKILL.md.

remediation.issue: Remote MCP endpoint and OAuth trust boundary
remediation.suggestion: Document that users should verify the Rube MCP endpoint and Twitter OAuth scopes before connecting an account.

remediation.issue: No explicit confirmation before public or destructive actions
remediation.suggestion: Require final user confirmation before publishing, deleting, unbookmarking, or unliking account content.

remediation.issue: Non-idempotent post creation can duplicate public posts
remediation.suggestion: Add retry guidance that checks recent posts or stores an operation marker before retrying post creation.

static_findings.snippet: - Active Twitter connection via `RUBE_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS` with toolkit `twitter`
- Always call `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` first to get current tool schemas
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
1. Verify Rube MCP is available by confirming `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` responds
- `media__media_ids`: Array of media ID strings for attachments
- `query`: Search query using Twitter search operators
- Empty results return `meta.result_count: 0` with no `data` field
- `ids`: Comma-separated user IDs for batch lookup
- `id`: User ID (from USER_LOOKUP_ME) for listing bookmarks
- `tweet_id`: Tweet ID to bookmark or unbookmark
- `id`: User ID for listing owned/member/followed lists
- `list_id`: List ID for specific list lookup
- `id`: User ID for listing liked posts
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
3. Pass media_id as string in media__media_ids array to TWITTER_CREATION_OF_A_POST
- FULL_ARCHIVE_SEARCH requires Academic Research or Enterprise access

semantic_findings.title: Authenticated Social Account Actions Need Confirmation
semantic_findings.description: The skill guides agents to create and delete posts through an authenticated Twitter/X account. It also notes that retries can create duplicate posts, but it does not require final user approval before public or destructive actions.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The create and delete workflow is explicit, and the non-idempotency warning confirms duplicate public posts are possible. The risk is contextual because legitimate automation is intended.

content.value_statement: Managing Twitter/X tasks across posts, searches, bookmarks, and lists can be repetitive. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code through Rube MCP workflows.
actual_capabilities: Connects to Rube MCP and checks Twitter toolkit availability.
Creates, looks up, and deletes Twitter/X posts.
Uploads images, videos, or GIFs before creating posts.
Searches recent posts, search counts, and archive search when access allows.
Looks up users, bookmarks, lists, liked posts, and unlikes.
limitations: Requires a connected Rube MCP server and active Twitter OAuth session.
Cannot bypass Twitter/X rate limits, access tiers, or account permissions.
Post creation is not idempotent; retries can create duplicate posts.
Tool schemas can change, so the skill requires tool search before action.

use_cases.title: Publish Approved Updates
use_cases.description: Create approved posts, attach media, verify the active account, and capture the resulting post ID.

use_cases.title: Research Recent Conversation
use_cases.description: Search recent posts, count matching results, and summarize topics around campaigns, brands, or events.

use_cases.title: Maintain Account Collections
use_cases.description: Review bookmarks, lists, and liked posts for the authenticated account and make approved updates.

prompt_templates.title: Post a Status Update
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the twitter-automation skill to create a post from this approved text: [text]. First confirm the active account, then return the post ID.

prompt_templates.title: Search Recent Posts
prompt_templates.prompt: Search recent Twitter/X posts for [query] from [start time] to [end time]. Summarize themes, top posts, and result count.

prompt_templates.title: Review Bookmarks
prompt_templates.prompt: List my recent bookmarks, group them by topic, and remove only the bookmark IDs that I explicitly approve.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Media Post Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Upload the attached media, draft a post with [message], check character limits, confirm the authenticated account, and wait for approval before publishing.

output_examples.input: Create a post announcing our webinar using the approved text and image.
output_examples.output: Confirmed the active account, uploaded the image, checked the text length, created the post, and returned the post ID.

output_examples.input: Search posts about our product launch from the last two days.
output_examples.output: Returned a concise summary of recent posts, common themes, notable authors, and the total result count.

output_examples.input: Show my bookmarked posts and remove the ones I approve.
output_examples.output: Listed recent bookmarks by topic, waited for approval, and removed only the selected bookmarked posts.

best_practices: Search current Rube tool schemas before each workflow.
Confirm the authenticated account and final text before public actions.
Check rate limits and duplicate-post risk before retrying failed requests.
anti_patterns: Retrying post creation after a timeout without checking for duplicates.
Publishing, deleting, unliking, or removing bookmarks without explicit approval.
Assuming archive search is available for every Twitter/X account.

faq.question: Does this skill need a Twitter/X account?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires an active Twitter connection through Rube MCP and the Twitter toolkit.

faq.question: Can it post media?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide image uploads and large media uploads before creating a post.

faq.question: Does it schedule posts?
faq.answer: No. The documented workflows create, delete, search, and manage Twitter/X objects, but scheduling is not listed.

faq.question: Can it search old posts?
faq.answer: Only if the connected account has archive search access. Recent search covers the last seven days.

faq.question: Does it store credentials?
faq.answer: No evidence found in the skill file. Authentication is handled through Rube MCP and Twitter OAuth.

faq.question: Is it safe for unattended posting?
faq.answer: Use caution. Public posting and deleting should require final human approval.
